opening: I have pain in my thigh.
It's in the upper part of my right thigh.
When I was 11 I had pain in my hip joint; it went away.
At that time they drew fluid from my hip joint with a needle under ultrasound, and the fluid showed no infection.
Six months ago I was hit by a car at the level of my knee; no fracture was found.

opening.text: I have pain in my thigh, specifically in the upper part of my right thigh. I should mention that six months ago I was hit by a car at the level of my knee, though no fracture was found. Also, when I was 11, I had pain in my hip joint that went away, and they drew fluid from it with a needle under ultrasound, which showed no infection.
